reapack.name: SK Drums Generator.lua
reapack.desc: SK Drums Generator : 16-step drum sequencer with velocity layers, note preview, presets and MIDI export

version.author: Studio Kozak
version.changelog: Rebuilt interface on the Studio Kozak dark/amber look. Step colours now follow the velocity legend on every instrument. Play / Stop and Preview buttons: Preview arms the target track on All MIDI Inputs so the note buttons audition through its sampler. Drum elements can be renamed, from the mapping panel or by double-clicking the name on the grid. The track a pattern was written to is remembered per project, so generating still works when nothing is selected in REAPER. Session tempo can be set from the top row. Regenerating replaces the previous pattern instead of stacking a new one over it, and counts as a single undo step. Timing and Var.Vel now default to 0. The auto-fill now closes bar 8 instead of bar 4. Saved patterns now remember their Swing, Timing and Var.Vel settings. The pattern being worked on is kept with the project, so closing the window no longer loses it.
